To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
tumor cells have multiple mechanisms to escape from immune surveillance and that tumor microenvironment can affect these escape mechanisms.

(a) Tumor antigen-specific cytotoxic lymphocytes can recognize tumor cells in vivo and can mediate tumor cell destruction; (b) Tumor antigen recognition by cytotoxic lymphocytes in vivo is inhibited by regulatory T cells; (c) Tumor antigen- specific cytotoxic lymphocytes undergo apoptosis in the tumor micro- environment.

tumor antigen-specific cytolytic T cells are not only negatively impacted by tumor cells but also by the tumor microenvironment, which includes regulatory T cells, T-cell apoptosis and altered tumor cell expression of histocompatability antigens.
